Both the depressed person and their roommate are often late with their bills. The roommate always has trouble keeping a job so they are often short of money, but the depressed person is just forgetful, even though they have a good job and should be able to pay everything on time. Who holds down a stable job?
A. The person who is depressed
B. Cannot answer
C. The roommate
